summary: Show |μ_k| ≤ 1 for k ∈ {p+1, p+p^e} and |μ_k| ≤ |ϖ^Q| otherwise. Only k = p + 1 + Q·I contribute; k·μ_k is p·ϖ^{QI}·(m′)_{k−1} = p ϖ^{QI}∑ n_{i+1}·(j+1)Z_{j+1}; only j = QJ contribute (hypothesis R), and the p-adic valuations of k and of i + 1 (`exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds`) balance the powers of ϖ.

steps.claim: Abbreviate P = ϖ^Q; rewrite the integrality hypotheses as bounds on all coefficients; p ≤ p^e = Q + 1.
steps.lean:
set P := ϖ ^ Q; simp [↓mem_range_seriesToCp, congruencePart] at *; have :=
    hQ ▸ le_self_pow (by omega) p

steps.claim: For every k: |μ_k| ≤ 1 if k ∈ {p+1, p+p^e}, and |μ_k| ≤ |P| otherwise.
steps.lean:
have {k} : ‖μ.coeff k‖ ≤ ite (k ∈ [p + 1, p + p ^ e]) 1 ‖P‖ := by
    by_cases g : k ≡ p + 1 [MOD Q]; by_cases! 2 < k
    obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := (modEq_iff_exists_eq_add (g.symm.le_of_lt_add (by omega))).1 g.symm
    obtain ⟨a, na, A⟩ := exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds (p + Q * I) 1 1 0 I hQ
    grw [← mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (na.trans_gt _), ← norm_mul, show _ * _ = p * P ^ I *
      (d⁄dX m).coeff _ by simp [hμ, pow_add, pow_mul, add_right_comm, ModEq.rfl, coeff_derivative,
      field], hm, coeff_mul, mul_sum, norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg _]
    simp [coeff_derivative] at *; rintro (_ | i) j x; swap; obtain ⟨J, rfl⟩ | _ := em (Q ∣ j)
    obtain ⟨_ : J ≤ I + 1, c, nc', B⟩ := by nlinarith, exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds i 1 0 J I hQ
    grw [(le_div_iff₀ _).2 (hn i), nc', ← sq_le_sq₀]; any_goals simp [*]; positivity
    by_cases! J ≠ 1; grw [hw]
    repeat simp [*, apply_ite, pow_right_comm _ I, field, ← cast_succ, -hQ, ← hQ, hQ ▸ nc, Fact.out,
      pow_le_pow_iff_right₀, norm_p_eq_inv, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]; clear! Z ϖ n m; cases he <;>
      grind [ModEq.eq_of_abs_lt]

steps.claim: Cases: if k ≢ p + 1 mod Q then μ_k = 0; if k ≤ 2 then μ_k = 0 (m₀ = m₁ = m₂ = 0); so assume k ≡ p + 1 mod Q and k > 2.
steps.lean: by_cases g : k ≡ p + 1 [MOD Q]; by_cases! 2 < k

steps.claim: |k|_p = |p + QI + 1|_p = p^{−a} with the bounds of `exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds` (x = p + QI, t = ε = 1, J = 0, k = I).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨a, na, A⟩ := exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds (p + Q * I) 1 1 0 I hQ

steps.claim: Multiply the claimed bound by |k|_p; it becomes a bound for |k·μ_k|.

k·μ_k = p·P^I·(m′)_{k−1} (from the definition of μ, k = p + 1 + QI and (m′)_{k−1} = k·m_k). (The written type is `_ * _ = p * P ^ I * (d⁄dX m).coeff _`; the recorded typed_fact is only its fragment up to the line break.)
steps.lean:
show _ * _ = p * P ^ I *
      (d⁄dX m).coeff _ by simp [hμ, pow_add, pow_mul, add_right_comm, ModEq.rfl, coeff_derivative,
      field]

steps.claim: Insert m′ = n·Z′, expand the coefficient of the product as ∑_{i+j=k−1} n_i·(Z′)_j, and bound the sum by the maximum of its terms (ultrametric inequality).
Consider a term n_{i+1}·(Z′)_j; if Q ∤ j then (Z′)_j = (j+1)Z_{j+1} = 0 (hypothesis R), so j = Q·J.
steps.lean: simp [coeff_derivative] at *; rintro (_ | i) j x; swap; obtain ⟨J, rfl⟩ | _ := em (Q ∣ j)

steps.claim: J ≤ I + 1, and |i + 1|_p = p^{−c} with the bounds of `exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds` (x = i, t = 1, ε = 0, J, k = I).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨_ : J ≤ I + 1, c, nc', B⟩ := by nlinarith, exists_norm_eq_inv_pow_bounds i 1 0 J I hQ

steps.claim: |n_{i+1}| ≤ |i + 1|_p⁻¹ (n′ integral) and |Z_{QJ+1}| = |ϖ^Q|⁻¹ for J = 1 (hypothesis nc); compare squares.
steps.lean: grw [(le_div_iff₀ _).2 (hn i), nc', ← sq_le_sq₀]; any_goals simp [*]; positivity

steps.claim: In each case the product of the bounds is ≤ 1 for k ∈ {p+1, p+p^e} and ≤ |P| otherwise: an inequality between powers of p and of |ϖ|, checked in the cases e = 1 and e = 2 from the exponent bounds (`grind`).
steps.lean:
repeat simp [*, apply_ite, pow_right_comm _ I, field, ← cast_succ, -hQ, ← hQ, hQ ▸ nc, Fact.out,
      pow_le_pow_iff_right₀, norm_p_eq_inv, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]; clear! Z ϖ n m; cases he <;>
      grind [ModEq.eq_of_abs_lt]

steps.claim: The three claims follow from the coefficient bound: the coefficients at p+1 and p+p^e have norm ≤ 1, and all other coefficients of μ are ≤ |P|, so (ϖ^Q)⁻¹ times the rest is integral.
